notes.title: 01.09.2025 Game update
notes.content:
Maintenance has been completed.

The following changes have been made to the game:

Dungeons:

🔹 Old dungeon stones have been removed and replaced with new ones
🔹 When selecting the Sky Fortress on the dungeon teleporter, the character is transferred to NPC High Priest Largal
🔹 The dungeon management menu has been removed from the dungeon manager NPC
🔹 The dungeon teleporter ownership menu has been updated

General Changes:

🔹 The NPC Coin Exchange Assistant now has a skill card combination menu
🔹 Resurrection window delay reduced from 5 seconds to 2 seconds
🔹 Help and Shop windows now close automatically upon death
🔹 Mounts can now be mounted/dismounted with a double-click or a hotkey (same as equipment)
🔹 Added commands:
  /ride — mount/dismount
  /sit — sit/stand

Interface:

🔹 Added quick access icons for key functions (e.g., guild buffs)
🔹 Management window opens with the T key
🔹 Updated commands linked to icons
🔹 Tooltips now display relevant commands when hovering over an icon

Guilds:

🔹 Maximum guild level increased to 20
🔹 Leveling beyond 16 costs 256M rupees
🔹 New guild buff buttons added: +10% and +15%
🔹 Guild level can only be raised once per week (resets on Monday at 00:00)
🔹 From level 10 onwards, 300 raid medals are required to level up
🔹 Required guild points for raids:

Ancient City Ruins — 10.0

Sky Fortress — 15.0

Twilight Dungeon — 20.0
🔹 Minimum guild level for raids: 10
🔹 Raids now drop Raid Medals in small amounts along with items

Raids & Sieges:

🔹 Low-level dungeon raids and sieges have been removed
🔹 Three new raid dungeons added:

Ancient City Ruins

Sky Fortress

Twilight Dungeon

Dungeon Ownership Buffs:

Ancient City Ruins
🔹 +3% final damage
🔹 +10% EXP, MP, Luck, Rupees, Drop Chance inside ruins

Sky Fortress
🔹 +4% final damage
🔹 +10% EXP, MP, Luck, Rupees, Drop Chance inside fortress

Twilight Underground City
🔹 +5% final damage
🔹 +10% EXP, MP, Luck, Rupees, Drop Chance inside city

Raid Rules:

🔹 Only guilds can register for raids (alliances do not count)
🔹 Raid duration: 1 hour
🔹 Period: Mon 00:00 ~ Sat 24:00
🔹 Ownership transfer: Sun 23:50
🔹 Dungeon ownership is automatically transferred based on raid results (no sieges)
🔹 The owning guild may defend their dungeon through raids
🔹 Only 1 raid attempt per day is allowed (counted from the start)
🔹 Abandoning a dungeon blocks raids until 24:00 of the same day
🔹 Buffs are now retained after death inside dungeons
🔹 Raid applications can be canceled during the week (if not yet completed)
🔹 If a guild abandons a dungeon, they cannot apply or form a raid group for 24 hours (previously 7 days)
🔹 Raid objective changed: now all monsters must be killed

Alliances:

🔹 Added alliance management commands:
  /gacreate [name] — create an alliance (guild leader only)
  /gainvite [guild] — invite a guild (alliance leader only)
  /gakick [guild] — expel a guild (alliance leader only)
  /gadestroy — disband the alliance (alliance leader only)
  /galeave — leave the alliance (if the leader leaves, the alliance disbands)

We wish you an enjoyable game!

notes.title: EPIC 9.9: TWILIGHT UNDERWORLD: MEDALS, NEW ARMOR, SKILLS FOR OT.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42541638/92ef73fb7ce95b0a1254487665a2f71dc2c5440c.png[/img]

For defeating monsters in the dungeon, you will receive different ingredients to create new armor and medals. Getting the items you want won't be easy, but we know you'll be able to pull it off.

New Armor.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42541638/255b1bcac9d6ed4bdf81abf2414de0a2ebe9a999.png[/img]

You can get a new set of twilight armor by upgrading a set of Lucis armor. To upgrade the armor you will need Twilight Crystals, which can be obtained by combining items dropped in the dungeon, and Twilight Ore.

For 1 Twilight Crystal, you will need 10 Timru Crystals, 10 Drago Crystals, and 10 Chaos Crystals.

You can get Timru crystals for defeating a Timru boss, Timru soldiers, Timru officer and Timru NOC.

Drago crystals are dropped from Drago soldiers, Drago officers and Drago NOCs.

Chaos Crystals you will get from Chaos Flight, Chaos Nom, Chaos Crowler and Chaos Phoenix.

Twilight Ore drops from all of the above monsters.

Below are the characteristics of the Twilight Armor. Lusiad's power is increased to 40 for the Twilight Armor set.

Set Bonus:
▪+20% Strength, Energy, Dexterity, Agility, Skill, Intelligence, Wisdom
▪+20% Physical Attack/Magic Attack. Attacks
▪+10% Max. XP/MP

Twilight Helmet:
▪+15% Evasion / Magic Resistance
▪+5% Physical Attack/Mag. Attacks.

Twilight Gloves:
▪+30 Attack Speed / Spell Reading Speed
▪+10% Accuracy / Magic Accuracy.

Twilight Boots:
▪+30 movement speed
▪+5% Physical Attack / Mag. Attacks.

Twilight Armor:
▪+25% Strength, Energy, Skill
▪+15% Physical Attack/Magic Attack. Attacks.
▪+10% Evasion

Twilight Armor :
▪+25% Dexterity, Dexterity, Energy
▪+15% Physical Attack / Mag. Attacks.
▪+10% Evasion

Twilight Cloak:
▪+25% Wisdom, Energy, Intelligence
▪+15% Physical Attacks / Magical Attacks. Attacks.
▪+10% Mag. Resistance

Twilight Cloak:
▪+25% Strength, Energy, Intelligence
▪+15% Physical Attack / Mag. Attacks.
▪+5% Evasion / Magic Resistance.

To create a Twilight Helmet, you will need: Lucis Helmet + Nusilith Helmet + Twilight Crystal x500 + Twilight Ore x50.
To create Twilight Gloves you will need: Lucis Gloves + Nusilith Gloves + Twilight Crystal x500 + Twilight Ore x50.
Twilight Boots: Lucis Boots + Nusilith Boots + Twilight Crystal x500 + Twilight Ore x50
Twilight Armor: Lucis Armor + Nusilith Armor + Twilight Crystal x1000 + Twilight Ore x100
Twilight Armor: Lucis Armor + Nusilith Armor + Twilight Crystal x1000 + Twilight Ore x100
Twilight Cloak: Lucis' Cloak + Nusilith Armor + Twilight Crystal x1000 + Twilight Ore x100
Twilight Cloak: Lucis' Cloak + Nusilith Armor + Twilight Crystal x1000 + Twilight Ore x100

To create twilight armor, you need to put the materials in the enchanting window.
Hint: to put a stack of materials at once, open the combo window first, put all the items you need in there and go back to the enchanting window.

Medals

New medals have been added to the game. You will be able to create a regular medal by using 1000 Simple Naha Blueprints or 500 Naha Blueprints or 100 Improved Naha Blueprints. If your creation attempt fails, you will receive 1 shard of the medal. For 10 shards, you will receive a regular medal.

Blueprints drop from monsters of the Twilight Underworld.
If you have a Naha Medal Shard, you can use it instead of a regular medal shard.

To identify the medal, you need to combine it with the Philosopher's Scroll and the Book of Secrets (sold at the Smuggler for 5 billion rupees) or the Power of Change: Medal and the Book of Secrets. Once identified, medals can be combined with Strength, Intelligence, and Health stones (purchased from the in-game store) to produce an improved medal.

The improved medal can be re-evaluated with the "Blessed Power of Change: medal" from the in-game store. All new improved medals can be sharpened to +20 and then gain +32 Lusiad power.

To sharpen from 0 to +20, you will need a Medal Cube (purchased from the arena item store) or an Ancient Medal Cube (can be created by combining 1 Medal Cube and an Ancient Stone (sold in the in-game store). If the sharpening fails, you can restore the item with Recovery Powder: Medal from the in-game store.

To increase Lusiad's strength to 32, you must use Lusiad's Strength: Medal (extracted from a +20 medal with the Lusiad's Strength Extractor).

Information on medal characteristics can be found below.

Normal Medal: +5% to stats (except luck)
Improved Health Medal: +15% Max. HP / Max. MP, +15% Physical Defense/Magic Defense, +15% HP Recovery.
Improved Strength Medal: +20% Physical Attack, +20 Crit Power.
Improved Intelligence Medal: +20% Magic Attack, +20 Crit Power.

Below you can see the medal sharpening table.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42541638/625a70dac657dbce9229abbf71c31f9172eb25a1.png[/img]

Random Skills

Added the ability to get a random skill for talent points.
Now you can get 2 additional new skills for your class when gaining certain profession levels. The chance of getting one is the same for all skills. It is not possible to get a skill for a class you are not currently in.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42541638/694ddd2565b0ecd73023c9825e14aecd9d027ce8.png[/img]

For 1 OT, you can gain one of the following skills.

List of random skills (1)*:
▪ Mask of Magic
▪ Predator of Sura
▪ Wild Instinct
▪ Apostle of Darkness
▪ The ultimate terror
▪ Deadly attack
▪ Pure magic
Blessing of Purified Water

Random skill list (2)*:
▪Mystic sword
▪ Fatal Link
▪ Angel's Deception
▪ Magic Swamp
▪ Dissecting the darkness
Mana Aura Crystal
▪ Self-Discipline: Intelligence
Berserk Energy
▪ Smooth Mana Energy
▪ The doom of reckless magic
▪ Mass Magic
▪ The instinct of the sharp beast.

*Note, skill names in game are subject to change.

Other innovations:

▪ Damage over time (poisons, bleeding, etc.) is now factored into damage reduction.
▪Arena for players above level 220 has been added. Level 220+ players can now purchase a Medal Cube from NIPs for arena points.
▪Buffs are now not removed from characters when entering the arena or participating in the "Bloody Battle".
▪The durability of creature cards is now 10 regardless of reinforcement (except +0).
▪ Increased the maximum level from 240 to 250.
▪Pet level increased to 220.

The game update is coming soon. Just a little bit of patience left.
We wish you a pleasant game!

notes.title: Epic 9.8 - Labyrinth of Light - already on the servers!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42541638/b7843672635f9022b0c5400593852537cf61d38c.png[/img]

Epic 9.8 "Labyrinth of Light" is already in the game!

[h1]General changes[/h1]

Increased character level cap to 240 and profession level cap to 120.
 
All first skills in the OT branches have been added to the 3rd level of study (at level 116 of the profession).
2 levels of learning have been added to skill enhancement skills for OT.
Below you can see the profession level required to level up the skill-enhancement of certain skills (from left to right in the skill tree):
[list]
[*] Skill 1 - Level 8 - at profession level 115
[*] Skill 1 - Level 9 - At profession level 118
[*] Skill 2 - Level 8 - at profession level 116
[*] Skill 2 - Level 9 - at profession level 119
[*] Skill 3 - Level 8 - at profession level 117
[*] Skill 3 - Level 9 - at profession level 120
[/list]
You also have the opportunity to further upgrade various passive skills at profession levels above 115.
 
In the Sky Fortress, the drop rate of loot has been increased - now it has become easier to collect sky accessories.
 
Coin Exchange Assistant can now open up to 5000 Skill Card Boxes at a time
 
Certain items now drop in boxes and can stack in one inventory slot:
[list]
[*] Creature Skill Artifact
[*] Soul of Mortis
[*] Ring of the Horadric
[*] Blue Kainen Necklace
[*] Red Kainen Earring
[*] Janua Mirror
[*] Shield of Janua
[/list]
Significantly reduced the weight of various items, including:
[list]
[*] Red Potion lvl 2 - 10
[*] Improved Red Potion lvl 2 - 10
[*] Blue Potion lvl 2 - 10
[*] Improved Blue Potion lvl 2 - 10
[*] Resurrection Scroll
[*] Creature Resurrection Book
[*] Sweet bread
[*] sweet water
[*] Red and blue gladiator potions
[*] Boxes with food, crystals and arena potions
[*] Keys
[*] Demonic Crystals can now be placed in storage.
[/list]
 
The limit of buffs that buff refresh scrolls and pet refresh scrolls work with has been expanded (now there will be more buffs that can be extended).
 
Perfect Block now has a cap of 70%.

[h1]New dungeon[/h1]

In epic 9.8, an important place is given to the new dungeon, from which it takes its name - "Labyrinth of Light".
 
You can get into the labyrinth starting from level 200 - it is on it that you will open a special chain of quests necessary to enter. Everything will start at the Messenger of the Community, Luciad Ruf, on the pier of the Dead City with the task “A Forgotten Reason”, and after a few quests you will find yourself in the Templar Refuge, where the entrance to the dungeon is located. Gather a party, it's not safe there!
 
Entering the dungeon, you will find yourself in a kind of "foyer" - on a small platform, surrounded on all sides by darkness. Use the login device to go further.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42541638/3cf22227f1c5bcad4e885b611e31fe30c69e29a2.png[/img]

The maze of light consists of 16 arena rooms that you have to go through, moving along the chain. How exactly to get through? Of course, kill all living things. But there is a catch: for the whole journey you are given 30 minutes and not a second more. The good news is that arenas can be jumped over. To do this, you only need a little knowledge.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42541638/b6977ef43bc5bfa32a17d6293fb867fb06d41cd2.png[/img]

The monsters in each arena are approximately the same, they differ only in level - the farther, the stronger they are. So, your goal is to kill everyone, and as quickly as possible - the less time it takes, the better the final reward will be.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42541638/6641bdc284c1984d7c7e515ba1370f6566482ebe.jpg[/img]

Each time you kill a guardian of rank A (B, C or D), all members of the group will be shown information about the remaining time and the number of the core of the Guard.
 
The number must be remembered (if you forget, just click on the sphere that remains after the death of the Guardian).
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42541638/b609fc6b0d611906a53e1519fb915f4aa4a20bc0.png[/img]

When all four Guardians are killed, add up their numbers and go with this knowledge to the portal with the tablets opposite the entrance.
 
Each tablet is a statement about your final number:
[list]
[*] This number is prime - true/false
[*] Is this fibonacci number true/false
[*] This number is even - True/False
[*] This number is square - true/false
[/list]
When the plate is up, it is in the True position, and when it is down, it is in the False position.
 
For example, the numbers of the core of the Guardians you killed are 2, 6, 4 and 3. Add these numbers and get 15. We look at the plates whether these statements are true or false for the number 15, put them in the right position and use the device to enter.
 
Each correct answer is a missed room, meaning with 4 correct answers you will move 4 rooms forward. If you answer all 4 questions incorrectly, you will be moved to the beginning.
 
At the tablets in the first room you will meet Templar Oui. Take the Quiz King quest from him to get an extra talent point as a reward!
 
In the last room you will find a chest with a reward. For every minute left on the timer by the time you get there, you will receive a 1% bonus to loot from the chest. The chest is opened by one member of the group, and everyone receives the reward.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42541638/a90406f444a1a4189935140d0171aec4166f85e7.png[/img]

By the way, if you are a convinced humanist or just don’t want to remember what “fibonacci” is, then keep a small cheat sheet:
 
[h1]New weapon[/h1]

Update 9.8 contains new weapons and shields. The good news is that it's crafted from your old weapon, so valuable stats, upgrades, and soul gems will stay with you.
 
So, to upgrade your weapon from the Isle of the Forgotten Gods, you will need:
[list]
[*] the main enchantment slot is your weapon from the Island,
[*] auxiliary cell - a similar unfinished weapon from the Circus (can be unopened),
[*] Material slot - Luciad's Pure Energy (25 for one-handed weapons and 50 for two-handed weapons).
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42541638/fb5aeb71307b402e7e44bd713f6cf26a8bdae7e2.png[/img]

The pure energy of Luciad can be obtained in the Labyrinth of Light.
 
After the change, the required weapon level becomes 210.

[h1]Upgrade after +20[/h1]

The enchant system up to +25, which has already become familiar, has undergone significant changes in epic 9.8. First of all, the maximum level of improvement is now +20, and further improvement comes from increasing the strength of Luciad.
 
As soon as your item becomes +20, it gains 1 level of Luciad's power.
 
Luciad's maximum power level is +32 for all old armor and weapons, and 40 for new pure white weapons and shields.
 
To increase the power level of Luciad, you will need to place the following items in the enchantment window:
[list]
[*] the main enchantment slot is your weapon or armor,
[*] auxiliary cell - Luciad's power: weapons / armor,
[*] material slot - pure or improved Luciad's cube.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42541638/4dc8d30fb833730ecc98553ea32c0149981d28f1.png[/img]

You can get Luciad Power for a weapon by combining any weapon that has at least one level of Luciad Power with the Luciad Power Extractor (purchased from a blacksmith for 200,000,000).
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42541638/6a3b62193aad4bf435a65ae61ead216b92c98ca6.png[/img]

The number of Extractors needed corresponds to the Luciad's power level of the original item: for example, to extract power from a weapon with a power level of 32, you would need 32 Extractors. Same with armor if you want to get Luciad's power for armor.
 
The Pure Cube of Luciad is used to boost Luciad's strength to +32 and below. You can get it as a drop from any bosses above level 150 or from the chest of the Labyrinth of Light.
 
Improved Luciad's Cube is needed to increase Luciad's strength from +33 to 40. You can get it in the Labyrinth of Light.
 
But what about things that have already been enchanted above +20? Don't worry, they will automatically change and get the Luciad power upgrade corresponding to their level of enchantment (statistics will not change):
Before -> Now (Luciad's power level)
[list]
[*] 20 -> 1
[*] 21 -> 2
[*] 22 -> 4
[*] 23 -> 8
[*] 24 -> 16
[*] 25 -> 32
[/list]

[h1]Awakening for weapons and accessories[/h1]

If earlier the number of lines in the awakening of weapons and accessories was 5, now you can increase their number to 7, as well as change some options at your discretion.
 
To do this, you will need special awakening stones: Blessed Awakening Stone and Blessed Awakening Stone: accessories.
 
To get a stone of blessed awakening, combine a regular stone of awakening with the pure energy of Luciad. Similarly - with a stone for accessories.
 
If you are not satisfied with any of the proposed options, but like all the others, you can easily change just one line with the help of awakening stone I - VII.
 
Here's how it works: choose which stitch you want to change and apply the appropriate stone.
Awakening stones for one line are purchased in the game store.

[h1]Soul Stones[/h1]

Serene Soul Stones (2) can now be upgraded to +5 or +10 with Energy Master. To upgrade to +5, you need Soulstone Essence (obtained in Labyrinth of Light).
 
Place the items of equipment that you want to improve the gems in in the Soul Gem Management window of the Energy Master. Place the essence of the soul stone in the bottom cell. Click on the button below the stone you want to upgrade.
 
Upgrading above +5 will require Unstable Soulstone Essence (purchased from the in-game store).
 
You can find out what characteristics the improvement will bring to each stone in the knowledge base.
 
We wish you good luck in exploring the Labyrinth of Light and, of course, have fun playing!

When the plate is up, it is in the True position, and when it is down, it is in the False position.
 
For example, the numbers of the core of the Guardians you killed are 2, 6, 4 and 3. Add these numbers and get 15. We look at the plates whether these statements are true or false for the number 15, put them in the right position and use the device to enter.
 
Each correct answer is a missed room, meaning with 4 correct answers you will move 4 rooms forward. If you answer all 4 questions incorrectly, you will be moved to the beginning.
 
At the tablets in the first room you will meet Templar Oui. Take the Quiz King quest from him to get an extra talent point as a reward!
 
In the last room you will find a chest with a reward. For every minute left on the timer by the time you get there, you will receive a 1% bonus to loot from the chest. The chest is opened by one member of the group, and everyone receives the reward.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42541638/a90406f444a1a4189935140d0171aec4166f85e7.png[/img]

By the way, if you are a convinced humanist or just don’t want to remember what “fibonacci” is, then keep a small cheat sheet:
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42541638/e57a63491339a29017bde7dae59068e40a115670.png[/img]

One key question remains - what is in the chest and what is it all for?
In the new dungeon, you can get Luciad's Pure Energy, Celestial Pearls, Chaos Skystone Fragments, Luciada's Pure and Improved Cubes, Soulstone Essence, and more!
 
And why we need all these new things, we will tell in the following diaries very soon. Follow the news!
